annotations.title: Sanctions check (OFAC screening): SDN screening for a crypto wallet or name

description: Check a crypto wallet against the OFAC SDN list before you pay it (EVM, BTC, TRX), or screen a person or company name, with aliases, against OFAC, the EU consolidated list, the UN Security Council list and the UK Sanctions List in one call. Returns a verdict (block, review, pass), each match with list, list ID, programme and strength, and every list's date. Screening aid, not legal advice. Use before paying; with wallet risk: check_counterparty. Example: address=0x098B716B8Aaf21512996dC57EB0615e2383E2f96. Price $0.009/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

address.description: Crypto address to check against OFAC (give address, name or both)

lists.description: Lists for a name: all (default), or any of ofac, eu, un, uk, comma-separated. Addresses are checked against OFAC, the only list that publishes crypto addresses

name.description: Person or company name; matches when every word appears in a listed name or alias
